samples.xml_description:
<module id="right_shifter">
    <description>Right shifter that shifts an 8-bit register to the right by one bit on each rising edge of the clock, inserting the new input bit d into the most significant position.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="d">Input signal to be right-shifted.</input>
        <output id="q" width_description="[7:0]">Output signal representing the result of the right shift operation.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description></parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        reg [7:0] q;
        initial begin
            q = 8'b0;
        end
        always @(posedge clk) begin
            q <= {q[6:0], d};
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Shifts the contents of the q register to the right by one bit and inserts the new input bit d into the most significant position on each rising edge of the clock.</implementation>
</module>
